streams.description: Network streams associated with this media.

audioCodec.description: Codec name used to encode audio for transmission on the network. Possible values are: unknown, invalid, cn, pcma, pcmu, amrWide, g722, g7221, g7221c, g729, multiChannelAudio, muchv2, opus, satin, satinFullband, rtAudio8, rtAudio16, silk, silkNarrow, silkWide, siren, xmsRta, unknownFutureValue.

averageAudioDegradation.description: Average Network Mean Opinion Score degradation for stream. Represents how much the network loss and jitter has impacted the quality of received audio.

averageAudioNetworkJitter.description: Average jitter for the stream computed as specified in RFC 3550, denoted in ISO 8601 format. For example, 1 second is denoted as 'PT1S', where 'P' is the duration designator, 'T' is the time designator, and 'S' is the second designator.

averageBandwidthEstimate.description: Average estimated bandwidth available between two endpoints in bits per second.

averageFreezeDuration.description: Average duration of the received freezing time in the video stream.

averageJitter.description: Average jitter for the stream computed as specified in RFC 3550, denoted in ISO 8601 format. For example, 1 second is denoted as 'PT1S', where 'P' is the duration designator, 'T' is the time designator, and 'S' is the second designator.

averagePacketLossRate.description: Average packet loss rate for stream.

averageRatioOfConcealedSamples.description: Ratio of the number of audio frames with samples generated by packet loss concealment to the total number of audio frames.

averageReceivedFrameRate.description: Average frames per second received for all video streams computed over the duration of the session.

averageRoundTripTime.description: Average network propagation round-trip time computed as specified in RFC 3550, denoted in ISO 8601 format. For example, 1 second is denoted as 'PT1S', where 'P' is the duration designator, 'T' is the time designator, and 'S' is the second designator.

averageVideoFrameLossPercentage.description: Average percentage of video frames lost as displayed to the user.

averageVideoFrameRate.description: Average frames per second received for a video stream, computed over the duration of the session.

averageVideoPacketLossRate.description: Average fraction of packets lost, as specified in RFC 3550, computed over the duration of the session.

endDateTime.description: UTC time when the stream ended. The DateTimeOffset type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC time. For example, midnight UTC on Jan 1, 2014 is 2014-01-01T00:00:00Z. This field is only available for streams that use the SIP protocol.

isAudioForwardErrorCorrectionUsed.description: Indicates whether the forward error correction (FEC) was used at some point during the session. The default value is null.

lowFrameRateRatio.description: Fraction of the call where frame rate is less than 7.5 frames per second.

lowVideoProcessingCapabilityRatio.description: Fraction of the call that the client is running less than 70% expected video processing capability.

maxAudioNetworkJitter.description: Maximum of audio network jitter computed over each of the 20 second windows during the session, denoted in ISO 8601 format. For example, 1 second is denoted as 'PT1S', where 'P' is the duration designator, 'T' is the time designator, and 'S' is the second designator.

maxJitter.description: Maximum jitter for the stream computed as specified in RFC 3550, denoted in ISO 8601 format. For example, 1 second is denoted as 'PT1S', where 'P' is the duration designator, 'T' is the time designator, and 'S' is the second designator.

maxPacketLossRate.description: Maximum packet loss rate for the stream.

maxRatioOfConcealedSamples.description: Maximum ratio of packets concealed by the healer.

maxRoundTripTime.description: Maximum network propagation round-trip time computed as specified in RFC 3550, denoted in ISO 8601 format. For example, 1 second is denoted as 'PT1S', where 'P' is the duration designator, 'T' is the time designator, and 'S' is the second designator.

postForwardErrorCorrectionPacketLossRate.description: Packet loss rate after FEC has been applied aggregated across all video streams and codecs.

rmsFreezeDuration.description: Average duration of the received freezing time in the video stream represented in root mean square.

startDateTime.description: UTC time when the stream started. The DateTimeOffset type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC time. For example, midnight UTC on Jan 1, 2014 is 2014-01-01T00:00:00Z. This field is only available for streams that use the SIP protocol.

videoCodec.description: Codec name used to encode video for transmission on the network. Possible values are: unknown, invalid, av1, h263, h264, h264s, h264uc, h265, rtvc1, rtVideo, xrtvc1, unknownFutureValue.

wasMediaBypassed.description: True if the media stream bypassed the Mediation Server and went straight between client and PSTN Gateway/PBX, false otherwise.

bandwidthLowEventRatio.description: Fraction of the call that the media endpoint detected the available bandwidth or bandwidth policy was low enough to cause poor quality of the audio sent.

basicServiceSetIdentifier.description: The wireless LAN basic service set identifier of the media endpoint used to connect to the network.

delayEventRatio.description: Fraction of the call that the media endpoint detected the network delay was significant enough to impact the ability to have real-time two-way communication.

dnsSuffix.description: DNS suffix associated with the network adapter of the media endpoint.

ipAddress.description: IP address of the media endpoint.

linkSpeed.description: Link speed in bits per second reported by the network adapter used by the media endpoint.

macAddress.description: The media access control (MAC) address of the media endpoint's network device. This value may be missing or shown as 02:00:00:00:00:00 due to operating system privacy policies.

port.description: Network port number used by media endpoint.

receivedQualityEventRatio.description: Fraction of the call that the media endpoint detected the network was causing poor quality of the audio received.

reflexiveIPAddress.description: IP address of the media endpoint as seen by the media relay server. This is typically the public internet IP address associated to the endpoint.

relayIPAddress.description: IP address of the media relay server allocated by the media endpoint.

relayPort.description: Network port number allocated on the media relay server by the media endpoint.

sentQualityEventRatio.description: Fraction of the call that the media endpoint detected the network was causing poor quality of the audio sent.

subnet.description: Subnet used for media stream by the media endpoint.

traceRouteHops.description: List of network trace route hops collected for this media stream.*

wifiBatteryCharge.description: Estimated remaining battery charge in percentage reported by the media endpoint.

wifiChannel.description: WiFi channel used by the media endpoint.

wifiMicrosoftDriver.description: Name of the Microsoft WiFi driver used by the media endpoint. Value may be localized based on the language used by endpoint.

wifiMicrosoftDriverVersion.description: Version of the Microsoft WiFi driver used by the media endpoint.

wifiSignalStrength.description: WiFi signal strength in percentage reported by the media endpoint.

wifiVendorDriver.description: Name of the WiFi driver used by the media endpoint. Value may be localized based on the language used by endpoint.

wifiVendorDriverVersion.description: Version of the WiFi driver used by the media endpoint.

cpuCoresCount.description: CPU number of cores used by the media endpoint.

cpuName.description: CPU name used by the media endpoint.

cpuProcessorSpeedInMhz.description: CPU processor speed used by the media endpoint.

feedback.description: The feedback provided by the user of this endpoint about the quality of the session.

identity.description: Identity associated with the endpoint. The identity property is deprecated and will stop returning data on June 30, 2026. Going forward, use the associatedIdentity property.

name.description: Name of the device used by the media endpoint.

callDurationSource.description: The source of the call duration data. If the call uses a third-party telecommunications operator via the Operator Connect Program, the operator can provide their own call duration data. In this case, the property value is operator. Otherwise, the value is microsoft.

callerNumber.description: Number that received the call for inbound calls or the number dialed for outbound calls. E.164 format.

callId.description: Call identifier. Not guaranteed to be unique.

callType.description: Indicates whether the call was a PSTN outbound or inbound call and the type of call, such as a call placed by a user or an audio conference.

charge.description: Amount of money or cost of the call that is charged to your account.

currency.description: Type of currency used to calculate the cost of the call. For details, see (ISO 4217.

destinationContext.description: Whether the call was domestic (within a country or region) or international (outside a country or region), based on the user's location.

duration.description: How long the call was connected, in seconds.

endDateTime.description: Call end time.

id.description: Unique call identifier. GUID.

inventoryType.description: User's phone number type, such as a service of toll-free number.

licenseCapability.description: The license used for the call.

operator.description: The telecommunications operator which provided PSTN services for this call. This might be Microsoft, or it might be a third-party operator via the Operator Connect Program.

startDateTime.description: Call start time.

tenantCountryCode.description: Country code of the tenant. For details, see ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

usageCountryCode.description: Country code of the user. For details, see ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

userId.description: Calling user's ID in Microsoft Graph. GUID. This and other user info will be null/empty for bot call types (ucapin, ucapout).

userPrincipalName.description: The user principal name (sign-in name) in Microsoft Entra ID. This is usually the same as the user's SIP address, and can be the same as the user's email address.

hopCount.description: The network path count of this hop that was used to compute the RTT.

ipAddress.description: IP address used for this hop in the network trace.

roundTripTime.description: The time from when the trace route packet was sent from the client to this hop and back to the client, denoted in ISO 8601 format. For example, 1 second is denoted as PT1S, where P is the duration designator, T is the time designator, and S is the second designator.

applicationVersion.description: Identifies the version of application software used by this endpoint.

headerValue.description: User-agent header value reported by this endpoint.

text.description: The feedback text provided by the user of this endpoint for the session.

tokens.description: The set of feedback tokens provided by the user of this endpoint for the session. This is a set of Boolean properties. The property names should not be relied upon since they may change depending on what tokens are offered to the user.

error.description: If status is failed, provides more information about the error that caused the failure.

status.description: Indicates the status of the asynchronous operation. Possible values are: unspecified, inprogress, completed, failed, unknownFutureValue.

startDateTime.description: The date and time when the particular activity occurred. The DateTimeOffset type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC time. For example, midnight UTC on Jan 1, 2014 is 2014-01-01T00:00:00Z.

performedBy.description: Represents an identity used to identify who is responsible for the activity.

error.description: Error information that explains the failure to process an external activity.

activitySettings.description: Collects configurable settings related to activities involving connector content.

configuration.description: Specifies additional application IDs that are allowed to manage the connection and to index content in the connection. Optional.

description.description: Description of the connection displayed in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Optional.

name.description: The display name of the connection to be displayed in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Maximum length of 128 characters. Required.

searchSettings.description: The settings configuring the search experience for content in this connection, such as the display templates for search results.

state.description: Indicates the current state of the connection. Possible values are: draft, ready, obsolete, limitExceeded, unknownFutureValue.

description.description: The description of the external group. Optional.

displayName.description: The friendly name of the external group. Optional.

members.description: A member added to an externalGroup. You can add Microsoft Entra users, Microsoft Entra groups, or an externalGroup as members.

acl.description: An array of access control entries. Each entry specifies the access granted to a user or group. Required.

content.description: A plain-text  representation of the contents of the item. The text in this property is full-text indexed. Optional.

properties.description: A property bag with the properties of the item. The properties MUST conform to the schema defined for the externalConnection. Required.

activities.description: Returns a list of activities performed on the item. Write-only.

type.description: The type of identity. Possible values are: user or group for Microsoft Entra identities and externalgroup for groups in an external system.

properties.description: The properties defined for the items in the connection. The minimum number of properties is one, the maximum is 128.

value.description: The unique identifer of the identity. For Microsoft Entra identities, value is set to the object identifier of the user, group or tenant for types user, group and everyone (and everyoneExceptGuests) respectively. For external groups value is set to the ID of the externalGroup

urlToItemResolvers.description: Specifies configurations to identify an externalItem based on a shared URL.

authorizedAppIds.description: A collection of application IDs for registered Microsoft Entra apps that are allowed to manage the externalConnection and to index content in the externalConnection.

id.description: The text identifier for the display template; for example, contosoTickets. Maximum 16 characters. Only alphanumeric characters allowed.

layout.description: The definition of the content's appearance, represented by an Adaptive Card, which is a JSON-serialized card object model.

priority.description: Defines the priority of a display template. A display template with priority 1 is evaluated before a template with priority 4. Gaps in priority values are supported. Must be positive value.

rules.description: Specifies additional rules for selecting this display template based on the item schema. Optional.

value.description: The content for the externalItem. Required.

itemId.description: Pattern that specifies how to form the ID of the external item that the URL represents. The named groups from the regular expression in urlPattern within the urlMatchInfo can be referenced by inserting the group name inside curly brackets.

urlMatchInfo.description: Configurations to match and resolve URL.

aliases.description: A set of aliases or a friendly name for the property. Maximum 32 characters. Only alphanumeric characters allowed. For example, each string may not contain control characters, whitespace, or any of the following: :, ;, ,, (, ), [, ], {, }, %, $, +, !, *, =, &, ?, @, #, /, ~, ', ', <, >, `, ^. Optional.

isQueryable.description: Specifies if the property is queryable. Queryable properties can be used in Keyword Query Language (KQL) queries. Optional.

isRefinable.description: Specifies if the property is refinable.  Refinable properties can be used to filter search results in the Search API and add a refiner control in the Microsoft Search user experience. Optional.

isRetrievable.description: Specifies if the property is retrievable. Retrievable properties are returned in the result set when items are returned by the search API. Retrievable properties are also available to add to the display template used to render search results. Optional.

isSearchable.description: Specifies if the property is searchable. Only properties of type String or StringCollection can be searchable. Nonsearchable properties aren't added to the search index. Optional.

labels.description: Specifies one or more well-known tags added against a property. Labels help Microsoft Search understand the semantics of the data in the connection. Adding appropriate labels would result in an enhanced search experience (for example, better relevance). Optional.The possible values are: title, url, createdBy, lastModifiedBy, authors, createdDateTime, lastModifiedDateTime, fileName, fileExtension, unknownFutureValue, iconUrl. Use the Prefer: include-unknown-enum-members request header to get the following value in this evolvable enum: iconUrl.

name.description: The name of the property. Maximum 32 characters. Only alphanumeric characters allowed. For example, each string may not contain control characters, whitespace, or any of the following: :, ;, ,, (, ), [, ], {, }, %, $, +, !, *, =, &, ?, @, #, /, ~, ', ', <, >, `, ^.  Required.

property.description: The property from the externalItem schema. Required.

values.description: A collection with one or many strings. One or more specified strings are matched with the specified property using the specified operation. Required.

searchResultTemplates.description: Enables the developer to define the appearance of the content and configure conditions that dictate when the template should be displayed. Maximum of 2 search result templates per connection.

baseUrls.description: A list of the URL prefixes that must match URLs to be processed by this URL-to-item-resolver.

urlPattern.description: A regular expression that will be matched towards the URL that is processed by this URL-to-item-resolver. The ECMAScript specification for regular expressions (ECMA-262) is used for the evaluation. The named groups defined by the regular expression will be used later to extract values from the URL.

priority.description: The priority which defines the sequence in which the urlToItemResolverBase instances are evaluated.

callbackConfiguration.description: The callback configuration for a custom task extension.

createdDateTime.description: When the custom task extension was created.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: When the custom extension was last modified.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

createdBy.description: The unique identifier of the Microsoft Entra user that created the custom task extension.Supports $filter(eq, ne) and $expand.

lastModifiedBy.description: The unique identifier of the Microsoft Entra user that modified the custom task extension last.Supports $filter(eq, ne) and $expand.

workflowScheduleIntervalInHours.description: The interval in hours at which all workflows running in the tenant should be scheduled for execution. This interval has a minimum value of 1 and a maximum value of 24. The default value is 3 hours.

deletedItems.description: Deleted workflows in your lifecycle workflows instance.

insights.description: The insight container holding workflow insight summaries for a tenant.

taskDefinitions.description: The definition of tasks within the lifecycle workflows instance.

workflows.description: The workflows in the lifecycle workflows instance.

workflowTemplates.description: The workflow templates in the lifecycle workflow instance.

completedDateTime.description: The date time that the run completed. Value is null if the workflow hasn't completed.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

failedTasksCount.description: The number of tasks that failed in the run execution.

failedUsersCount.description: The number of users that failed in the run execution.

lastUpdatedDateTime.description: The datetime that the run was last updated.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

scheduledDateTime.description: The date time that the run is scheduled to be executed for a workflow.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

startedDateTime.description: The date time that the run execution started.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

successfulUsersCount.description: The number of successfully completed users in the run.

totalUnprocessedTasksCount.description: The total number of unprocessed tasks in the run execution.

totalUsersCount.description: The total number of users in the workflow execution.

arguments.description: Arguments included within the task.  For guidance to configure this property, see Configure the arguments for built-in Lifecycle Workflow tasks. Required.

continueOnError.description: A Boolean value that specifies whether, if this task fails, the workflow stops, and subsequent tasks aren't run. Optional.

description.description: A string that describes the purpose of the task for administrative use. Optional.

displayName.description: A unique string that identifies the task. Required.Supports $filter(eq, ne) and orderBy.

executionSequence.description: An integer that states in what order the task runs in a workflow.Supports $orderby.

isEnabled.description: A Boolean value that denotes whether the task is set to run or not. Optional.Supports $filter(eq, ne) and orderBy.

taskDefinitionId.description: A unique template identifier for the task. For more information about the tasks that Lifecycle Workflows currently supports and their unique identifiers, see Configure the arguments for built-in Lifecycle Workflow tasks. Required.Supports $filter(eq, ne).

taskProcessingResults.description: The result of processing the task.

continueOnError.description: Defines if the workflow will continue if the task has an error.

description.description: The description of the taskDefinition.

displayName.description: The display name of the taskDefinition.Supports $filter(eq, ne) and $orderby.

parameters.description: The parameters that must be supplied when creating a workflow task object.Supports $filter(any).

version.description: The version number of the taskDefinition. New records are pushed when we add support for new parameters.Supports $filter(ge, gt, le, lt, eq, ne) and $orderby.

completedDateTime.description: The date time when taskProcessingResult execution ended. Value is null if task execution is still in progress.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

createdDateTime.description: The date time when the taskProcessingResult was created.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

failureReason.description: Describes why the taskProcessingResult has failed.

startedDateTime.description: The date time when taskProcessingResult execution started. Value is null if task execution has not yet started.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

completedDateTime.description: The date time that the associated run completed. Value is null if the run has not completed.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

failedUsersCount.description: The number of users in the run execution for which the associated task failed.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

lastUpdatedDateTime.description: The date and time that the task report was last updated.

runId.description: The unique identifier of the associated run.

startedDateTime.description: The date time that the associated run started. Value is null if the run has not started.

successfulUsersCount.description: The number of users in the run execution for which the associated task succeeded.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

totalUsersCount.description: The total number of users in the run execution for which the associated task was scheduled to execute.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

unprocessedUsersCount.description: The number of users in the run execution for which the associated task is queued, in progress, or canceled.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

failedTasksCount.description: The number of tasks that failed in the workflow execution.

scheduledDateTime.description: The date time that the workflow is scheduled to be executed for a user.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

startedDateTime.description: The date time that the workflow execution started. Value is null if the workflow execution has not started.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

totalTasksCount.description: The total number of tasks that in the workflow execution.

totalUnprocessedTasksCount.description: The total number of unprocessed tasks for the workflow.

workflowVersion.description: The version of the workflow that was executed.

deletedDateTime.description: When the workflow was deleted.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

id.description: Identifier used for individually addressing a specific workflow.Supports $filter(eq, ne) and $orderby.

nextScheduleRunDateTime.description: The date time when the workflow is expected to run next based on the schedule interval, if there are any users matching the execution conditions. Supports $filter(lt,gt) and $orderby.

version.description: The current version number of the workflow. Value is 1 when the workflow is first created.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

taskReports.description: Represents the aggregation of task execution data for tasks within a workflow object.

versions.description: The workflow versions that are available.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: When the workflow was last modified.

createdBy.description: The user who created the workflow.

lastModifiedBy.description: The unique identifier of the Microsoft Entra identity that last modified the workflow.

description.description: The description of the workflowTemplate.

displayName.description: The display name of the workflowTemplate.Supports $filter(eq, ne) and $orderby.

executionConditions.description: Conditions describing when to execute the workflow and the criteria to identify in-scope subject set.

tasks.description: Represents the configured tasks to execute and their execution sequence within a workflow. This relationship is expanded by default.

operationStatus.description: Operation status that's provided by the Azure Logic App indicating whenever the Azure Logic App has run successfully or not. Supported values: completed, failed, unknownFutureValue.

values.description: The values of the parameter.

rule.description: The rule for the subject set. Lifecycle Workflows supports a rich set of user properties for configuring the rules using $filter query expressions. For more information, see supported user and query parameters.

manifests.description: Represents metadata for the exported data.

operations.description: Represents an operation to export the billing data of a partner.

blobCount.description: The total file count for this partner tenant ID.

blobs.description: A collection of blob objects that contain details of all the files for the partner tenant ID.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time when a manifest resource was created. The timestamp type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC. For example, midnight UTC on Jan 1, 2014 is 2014-01-01T00:00:00Z.

dataFormat.description: The billing data file format. The possible value is: compressedJSONLines. Each blob is a compressed file and data in the file is in JSON lines format. Decompress the file to access the data.

eTag.description: Version of data represented by the manifest. Any change in eTag indicates a new data version.

partitionType.description: Indicates the division of data. If a given partition has more than the supported number, the data is split into multiple files, each file representing a specific partitionValue. By default, the data in the file is partitioned by the number of line items.

partnerTenantId.description: The Microsoft Entra tenant ID of the partner.

rootDirectory.description: The root directory that contains all the files.

sasToken.description: The SAS token for accessing the directory or an individual file in the directory.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the manifest schema.

createdDateTime.description: The start time of the operation. The timestamp type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC. For example, midnight UTC on Jan 1, 2014 is 2014-01-01T00:00:00Z.

lastActionDateTime.description: The time of the last action of the operation. The timestamp type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC. For example, midnight UTC on Jan 1, 2014 is 2014-01-01T00:00:00Z.

status.description: The status of the operation. Possible values are: notStarted, running, completed, failed, unknownFutureValue.

name.description: The blob name.

subject.description: The subject of this Teams message.

threadId.description: Identifier of the channel or chat that this message is part of.

threadType.description: The Teams message type. Supported values are: Chat, Topic, Space, and Meeting.

urls.description: The URLs contained in this Teams message.
